name: Traditional Chinese culture is an important part of our national identity.
trans: 中国传统文化是我们民族认同的重要组成部分。

name: As college students, we should inherit and carry forward traditional culture.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该传承和弘扬传统文化。

name: Protecting cultural heritage is not only the government’s duty but also ours.
trans: 保护文化遗产不仅是政府的责任，也是我们的责任。

name: We can celebrate traditional festivals and learn traditional customs to keep our culture alive.
trans: 我们可以通过庆祝传统节日、学习传统习俗来让文化焕发生机。

name: Traditional virtues such as honesty, filial piety and harmony are still valuable today.
trans: 诚实、孝道、和谐等传统美德在今天仍然有价值。

name: Cultural exchange helps the world understand China better.
trans: 文化交流有助于世界更好地了解中国。

name: We should integrate tradition with modernity and innovate while inheriting.
trans: 我们应该将传统与现代相结合，在传承中创新。

name: Learning traditional art forms like calligraphy and paper-cutting can help us appreciate the charm of traditional culture.
trans: 学习书法、剪纸等传统艺术形式有助于我们欣赏传统文化的魅力。

name: The Internet provides a good platform to spread Chinese culture to the world.
trans: 互联网为向世界传播中国文化提供了良好平台。

name: Young people should take an active part in cultural activities and enhance cultural confidence.
trans: 年轻人应积极参加文化活动，增强文化自信。

name: We should respect cultural diversity while protecting our own cultural heritage.
trans: 在保护自身文化遗产的同时，我们应尊重文化多样性。

name: Only by inheriting and innovating can we make traditional culture more popular among young people.
trans: 只有传承并创新，我们才能让传统文化更受年轻人欢迎。

name: It is widely acknowledged that traditional culture plays an important role in national development.
trans: 众所周知，传统文化在国家发展中起着重要作用。

name: There is no denying that cultural heritage is a precious treasure of human civilization.
trans: 不可否认，文化遗产是人类文明的宝贵财富。

name: As college students, we should learn traditional culture and spread it to others.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该学习传统文化并将其传播给他人。

name: Only by inheriting and innovating can we keep traditional culture alive.
trans: 只有传承并创新，我们才能让传统文化焕发生机。

name: While protecting traditional culture, we should also integrate it with modern life.
trans: 在保护传统文化的同时，我们也应将其与现代生活相结合。

name: Taking an active part in cultural activities enables us to better understand and appreciate traditional culture.
trans: 积极参加文化活动使我们能够更好地理解和欣赏传统文化。
